critical_code_review_comments: P&L calculations verified correct: Net Profit = Gross Profit - GRN Loss - Variable Exp - Fixed Exp
GRN Loss correctly allocated proportionally to QC customers based on sales share
Rejection correctly allocated proportionally to Retail customers based on sales share
Customer modal Daily Avg uses periodDays (total calendar days) instead of active days for consistency with dashboard
